records.observation: Continuity across delegation and separately authorized evidence roles; published vectors and preserved/violated/unresolved outcomes
records.limitation: Author reports vector agreement; neither independently reproduced here nor an adopted standard
records.action: Review Apache-2.0 reference repository and data-specific license before importing rights-cleared vectors; map role mismatch, missing effect, invocation substitution, late decision, cross-packet unknown and delegation widening to existing authority experiments
records.acceptance: Pinned corpus and method; separate oracle, explicit failures/unknowns, effect log and independent reproduction

records.observation: DIF report separates capability, authority, decision, enforcement and oversight
records.limitation: Steering approval pending; report is not a protocol or certification
records.action: Use #4703 reciprocal contract and #3598 charter-approval lane; map narrowed authority, fail-safe unavailability, revocation and human escalation to existing Layer-0 host/executor tests
records.acceptance: Explicit decision-to-enforcement separation; no production effect until owner-authorized scope and independent readback

records.observation: Public registry status lookup distinguishes ACTIVE, REVOKED and UNKNOWN; further history features proposed
records.limitation: Current registry status alone proves neither holder identity nor permission; draft reports deployment, not independently verified here
records.action: Map public registry status as context only; exercise stale ACTIVE, copied identifier, revoked, unknown and missing-history cases; do not add a parallel registry
records.acceptance: Fail closed on missing live authority; do not substitute status for cryptographic principal binding or historical authority

records.observation: 97/97 MCP checks over 30 days; 54 listed tools; reported initialization 138 ms; summary still describes 13 tools
records.limitation: Independent directory availability check, not functional safety, usage or commercial traction
records.action: Use existing capability-parity gate #4704 to reconcile versioned inventories; keep old dated observation intact
records.acceptance: Canonical count and post-release live parity, then neutral external re-read
